description: This file defines a React component named DependencyList used for managing filter dependencies in a UI, including styled components, internal state management, and interaction logic.

classes.name: DependencyList
classes.description: React component for managing filter dependencies with collapsible UI and list management.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook for side effects, used here to clean up invalid dependencies when available filters change.

methods.name: useState
methods.description: React hook for managing component state, used here to track list of dependencies.

methods.name: onCheckChanged
methods.description: Handles toggling of dependency dependency state, suggesting dependencies if enabled.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds a new filter dependency from available filters.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates a specific dependency in the list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Removes a dependency from the list.
